title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Elchemy is building the cross-border marketplace for specialty chemicals, a $800B industry that still runs on emails, spreadsheets, phone calls and personal relationships. We connect manufacturers across Asia with buyers across the US and Europe, and we’re replacing that fragmented, opaque process with software.

In 4 years, we’ve scaled to customers in 55+ countries and suppliers in 25+ countries, and we’ve done it on a proprietary technology platform that keeps manual work to a minimum. That platform is the product. Every quote, quality check, document, shipment and payment flows through systems we’ve built ourselves, which means we have deep, structured data on how global chemical trade actually works.

Now we’re building what comes next:
**the largest B2B chemicals marketplace, powered by AI agents.**
We believe that in the near future, agents will make a large share of procurement and sales decisions. Whoever builds the infrastructure those agents run on, with the data, trust and rails to transact across borders, will define how the industry works. We want to be that company, and we’re early enough that the architecture is still being written.

We’re backed by Prime Venture Partners and Info Edge Ventures. Our team includes alumni of IITs, IIMs and NITs, plus people who have built and scaled startups and worked at global multinationals.

**What you’ll do**

* Design and build the Django backend that runs Elchemy’s operations and powers our marketplace. You’ll own architecture, data models and APIs from first design to production.
* Own features end to end. Turn ambiguous business problems into simple, shippable systems, and deploy and monitor them in production.
* Our systems handle multi-currency transactions, compliance documentation, supplier and product data, and shipments across borders. Data integrity and reliability matter here because real orders depend on them.
* Use AI coding tools to move faster, and review their output with a critical eye. Help us find where LLMs add real value in the product.
* Own deployment, monitoring and uptime on AWS, and find and fix performance bottlenecks before they hurt users.
* Lead through code reviews, clear documentation and sound engineering practices. Mentor engineers as the team grows, and have a real say in technical direction.
* Partner closely with product, design and frontend to decide what gets built and why, not just how.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical disciplines from a Tier-1/2 college. Strong CS fundamentals and good system design instincts. You can explain tradeoffs and design something that holds up as load and complexity grow.
* 5+ years building and running production backend systems, with strong Python and Django (including Django REST Framework).
* Solid fundamentals and proven experience of working with data pipelines, event driven architecture, and large-scale backend systems.
* Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, and keeping data correct as systems grow.
* Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform.
* Production experience on AWS (such as EC2, RDS, S3,DynamoDB, Cloudfront, Lambda, Bedrock) or similar GCP services.
* Experience integrating LLMs into products (LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic APIs) or working with third-party and open-source integrations.
* Strong code-reading and debugging skills. You can drop into an unfamiliar service and find what’s wrong.
* Real fluency with AI coding tools: you know when to trust them, how to prompt them well, and how to trim and correct what they produce.
* An ownership mindset. You’re comfortable in a small team without a dedicated QA function, and you take responsibility for quality, testing and reliability.

title: Data Engineering Tech Lead
description:
As Data Engineer Lead, you'll own the design, reliability, and evolution of Bisviews' data platform.

Some data infrastructure is already in place, so we're looking for someone who can confidently assess what exists, fix what's broken, and build a scalable foundation for analytics, trust and safety, and product features.

You'll set technical direction for data engineering, guide other engineers, and collaborate closely with backend engineers, product, design, QA, and leadership to turn raw platform data into trustworthy, usable information.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Platform Audit & Strategy

Review and assess the existing data sources, pipelines, storage, and reporting setup.

Identify gaps, data quality issues, technical debt, and performance or cost bottlenecks.

Define and document the target data architecture and a phased roadmap to reach it.

Establish data engineering standards, conventions, and documentation.

2. Data Pipelines & Infrastructure

Design, build, and maintain reliable batch and streaming pipelines (ETL/ELT).

Ingest data from the core application database, third-party services, and event tracking.

Build and manage the BigQuery data warehouse that powers analytics and product features.

Orchestrate, schedule, and monitor workflows with clear alerting and recovery.

Optimise pipelines for performance, scalability, and cloud cost.

3. Data Modelling & Analytics Enablement

Design clean, well-documented data models for reviews, businesses, users, reports, and trust signals.

Build curated datasets and metrics layers for product, growth, and operations dashboards.

Partner with product and leadership to define core KPIs and ensure one source of truth.

Support self-serve analytics through BI tooling.

4. Trust, Safety & Data Products

Provide the data foundations for fake review detection, fraud signals, and business trust scoring.

Work with backend engineers to expose data products to the platform through APIs or services.

Support ML or rules-based models with feature pipelines and well-labelled training data.

5. Data Quality, Governance & Security

Implement data quality checks, testing, lineage, and observability.

Enforce access controls, PII handling, retention, and secure data practices.

Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across the regions we operate in (e.g. GDPR, NDPR).

6. Leadership & Delivery

Lead and mentor a team of data engineering interns: assign and plan their work, review their code, and support their growth.

Translate business requirements into technical plans, estimates, and priorities.

Participate in sprint planning, engineering discussions, and team meetings.

Provide regular progress updates and communicate risks and blockers early.

Support deployments and troubleshoot production data issues.

Our Tech Stack

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

BigQuery (data warehouse)

Cloud Storage

Pub/Sub and Dataflow (streaming and processing)

Cloud Composer (Airflow) for orchestration

dbt (transformation)

Python and SQL

6+ years of professional data engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a lead or senior ownership role.

Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.

Proven experience designing and running production data pipelines and warehouses.

Hands-on experience with Airflow (ideally Cloud Composer) or similar orchestration tools.

Experience with dbt or similar transformation and modelling frameworks.

Strong understanding of data modelling (dimensional, event-based) and warehouse design.

Hands-on experience with GCP data services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Composer.

Experience with data quality testing, monitoring, and observability.

Solid understanding of data security, PII handling, and data privacy regulations.

Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.

Experience mentoring junior engineers or interns.

Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience with streaming pipelines using Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), or Kafka.

Experience supporting machine learning, fraud detection, or trust and safety systems.

Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Looker, or Metabase.

Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and containerisation.

Familiarity with search and indexing tools such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

Experience with multi-country or multi-region data and compliance.

Previous experience on marketplaces, review platforms, or other consumer-facing products.

Initial Expectations

Audit the existing data sources, pipelines, and reporting setup, and document key findings.

Identify and prioritise data quality issues, technical debt, and architectural improvements.

Propose a target data architecture and a phased roadmap.

Stabilise critical pipelines and establish monitoring and alerting.
